These MIT-licensed modules are adapted from HenryXiaoYang/realtime-tex-vsc-plugin:
https://github.com/HenryXiaoYang/realtime-tex-vsc-plugin

The upstream license is preserved in LICENSE. The code provides exact font outlines,
display-list painting, paragraph overlay placement, and text/source alignment.
Imports were adapted to this local directory. Backend font loading and Type1
outline conversion live in scripts/latex/vendor and retain the same license.

The engine used by this integration is the checksum-verified realtime-tex v0.0.6
Windows release. The runtime is installed locally and is not included in Git.
